subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace root, or should external references stay behind the fs-safe workspace boundary with filtering or neutral UI state?
rationale: The PR fixes a real UI confusion by crossing a file metadata boundary that current Gateway helpers deliberately keep inside fs-safe workspace access, so automation should not choose the permanent security/product semantics.

options.title: Restore The Workspace Boundary
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and handle external entries with filtering or a neutral non-missing state that does not disclose host filesystem metadata.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land only a rebased layout fix if needed and leave external-file/directory semantics to the linked workspace-panel issue.

options.title: Accept External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external path metadata only with explicit security acceptance, protocol expectations, and tests for absolute paths and symlink targets.

recommendation.title: Restore The Workspace Boundary
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and handle external entries with filtering or a neutral non-missing state that does not disclose host filesystem metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original workspace rail feature and have recent nearby boundary/refactor history, making them the best available owner for the security/product call.
